technical_smoke.purpose: mask-semantics, exact-edge, component-splice, and layer-band implementation audit only
passed_checks: standard cached clean and explicit-4D clean states were elementwise identical at L15/L16/L24
all 36 attention layers received a boolean [1,1,suffix_query,absolute_key] mask
each exact-edge intervention changed exactly one allowed query-key entry
all marker K-only, V-only, K+V and layer-band branches completed

marker_component_scan.discovery_selection: argmax of K versus V by within-seed bidirectional mean donor-axis progress at L24
marker_component_scan.KV_role: joint-effect reference; excluded from K-versus-V winner selection

layer_band_scan.discovery_selection: argmax pre-read K+V band by within-seed bidirectional mean donor-axis progress at L24

exact_attention_edge_scan.cache: clean event-branch KV cache; no cache fields are edited
exact_attention_edge_scan.mask: boolean 4D causal allowed-edge mask over cached suffix queries by absolute keys
exact_attention_edge_scan.intervention_scope: one query-key entry across all layers and heads

query_roles.target_marker: last token of the original next item's registered marker
query_roles.target_boundary: registered post-item boundary of the original next item

branches: valid history: progress is toward markerless custom-4D clean state
markerless history: same absolute-position mask; progress is toward valid custom-4D clean state
exact_attention_edge_scan.kernel_nuisance_control: all edge effects are measured against event-branch-specific explicit-4D clean baselines
exact_attention_edge_scan.discovery_selection: between target_marker and target_boundary, choose the query with larger valid-branch inserted-marker-edge donor-axis progress at L24

confirmation_primary_tests.estimand: per-seed bidirectional mean L24 donor-axis progress for the discovery-selected all-layer K-only or V-only marker splice
per-seed selected pre-read K+V band progress minus the mean progress of the other five pre-read K+V bands, after averaging directions at L24

per-seed valid inserted-marker-edge progress minus one half the markerless same-position progress and one half the mean valid-branch progress of the four non-marker key controls, at the discovery-selected query and L24

secondary_descriptive_contrasts: selected component minus the other of K-only/V-only
K-only plus V-only versus joint K+V to assess additivity or synergy
selected band versus each individual nonselected band
valid marker-edge effect versus each semantic key control
valid marker-edge effect versus markerless same-position control
interpretation_limits: A K-only or V-only cache splice identifies which cached field is sufficient to transport donor history under this intervention; it does not prove that the untouched field is unused naturally.
A four-layer band localizes causal sufficiency to a depth interval but does not isolate a head.
An all-layer/all-head exact edge mask tests necessity of one token-to-token route; failure can mean redundant routing rather than absence of marker-ledger use.
Discovery-selected cells are exploratory until replicated on the untouched confirmation cohort.
